Subject: Intro demo & technical owner alignment — next steps

Hi Alice / Tom — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery and proposed next steps so we can lock the 30-min intro demo: 

Recap (1-2 lines):
- You’re evaluating inference for document ingestion and retrieval at Kestrel (high throughput, multi-tenant segmentation).
- Primary success criteria: sub-100ms tail latency for short queries, predictable per-token cost, and auditability for data retention.

What I suggest next: schedule a 30-minute demo (product tour + brief technical Q&A). Please confirm who from your side should join (technical owner, security, procurement) so we can tailor the agenda. 

Three slot options that work for our team (all PT):
- Option A: Mon Aug 10 — 10:00–10:30 AM PT
- Option B: Tue Aug 11 — 4:00–4:30 PM PT (preferred for engineering attendees)
- Option C: Wed Aug 12 — 8:30–9:00 AM PT

If you’re able to confirm one of these (or send a 1–2 other preferred times), I’ll send a calendar invite and a short pre-demo checklist. I’m including Marissa (contracts/procurement) on cc so she can start the procurement thread once we have timing.

Attached: redwood-1pager.pdf (short capabilities summary), pre-demo-checklist.docx (what to have handy).

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

Best,

Proposed 30-min agenda (high level):
- 0–8 min: Product tour focused on serving/runtime and routing (what matters for latency/cost)
- 8–18 min: Demo of a short ingestion -> query flow (KV cache + batching behavior)
- 18–28 min: Technical Q&A (Tom + Security) + next steps
- 28–30 min: Logistics and procurement/PO checklist (Marissa to run)

Marissa — can you please prepare a one-page procurement checklist we can share in the invite (SLA & billing cadence, data residency options, onboarding timeline, initial trial commit)? If you want, I can draft the MAP and share it here — I attached a working draft (mutual-action-plan-draft.pdf) for your reference.

I’ll send the calendar invite with the attached one-pager and the pre-demo checklist first thing this morning.

Thanks,
Ben
